notes.title: 【罪業狂襲FrenzyRetribution Update】
notes.notes:
Tutorial system:
Fixed partial text word problem, the additional part did not explain the Tutorial.
Move some of the in-game tutorial points to the first level
Note: All tutorial can be read in the gallery first

Camera section:
Fixed an issue where the rotation speed could not keep up when the mouse was rotated
Adding a viewing angle mode, canceling the camera's following inertia, more suitable for mouse and keyboard
The additional angle of view operation reverse can adjust up and down, left and right reverse
Fine-tuning the angle of view when locked
Can be adjusted in "Options"

Protagonist:
Slightly shorten the recovery time in getting hit animation.
Perfect counterattack increases 1 frame.
Increased weapon fever consumption in berserk mode.

Boss related:
When the first stage Boss blood is zero, the player attack will force into execution.
Correcting airborne deaths during grab animation.
Fixed the problem that would be repelled by Boss's long-range attack at a normal counter.
Correct the problem of the perfect counter stun amount.

Score related:
Correct no damage score.

Gallery correction:
Story scroll can't scroll problem.

Other:
Fixed an issue where the displacement around the monster was not correct during the execution.
